column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 22 (E99012): kilas balik pembubaran Griffin; Lee-Enfield mendorong
# Tokarev merintis Griffin Alumni Association.
# Tetap Inggris: Tokarev, Griffin, P.M.C., SPAS-12, K2, MDR, Kuro, Cyber Media, URNC,
# Commander, Makarov, Lee-Enfield, Helian, Dandelion, Frame, neural cloud, Doll,
# White Zone, Green Zone, Yellow Zone, Griffin Alumni Association.
(Sometimes, Tokarev feels that a sunny day is exceptionally suitable for saying goodbye.)
column2: (Kadang Tokarev merasa hari yang cerah luar biasa cocok untuk berpamitan.)

column1: (She can't remember who had the sudden inspiration to insist on choosing this place for the farewell. The thick clouds and bright sunlight in the sky seem to act as a buffer isolating sadness, making the parting seem less gloomy and rainy, and preventing those left behind from losing their dignity.)
column2: (Dia tidak ingat siapa yang tiba-tiba dapat ilham dan memaksa memilih tempat ini untuk perpisahan. Awan tebal dan sinar matahari yang cerah di langit seolah jadi penyangga yang mengisolasi kesedihan, membuat perpisahannya terasa tidak sesuram hujan, dan mencegah mereka yang ditinggalkan kehilangan harga diri.)

column1: (Yes, it is now... the final stage of Griffin facing complete dismantling and reorganization.)
column2: (Ya, sekarang adalah... tahap terakhir Griffin menghadapi pembongkaran dan penataan ulang yang menyeluruh.)

column1: (Soon, this legendary P.M.C. that changed the fates of countless people will completely cease to exist.)
column2: (Sebentar lagi, P.M.C. legendaris yang mengubah nasib orang tak terhitung ini akan benar-benar tidak ada lagi.)

column1: Tokarev, I'm ready to head out!
column2: Tokarev, aku siap berangkat!

column1: I checked, and not far from here, there's an Italian fast-food restaurant hiring an intern chef. I think this position is practically tailor-made for me!
column2: Aku sudah cek, tidak jauh dari sini ada restoran cepat saji Italia yang mencari koki magang. Kurasa posisi itu benar-benar dijahit khusus untukku!

column1: As long as it makes you happy, then it's the best choice.
column2: Selama itu membuatmu bahagia, itu pilihan terbaik.

column1: Please be sure to stay safe on the road, Miss SPAS-12. Also, please don't rush when tasting delicious food, be careful not to choke like before.
column2: Tolong pastikan kau selamat di jalan, Miss SPAS-12. Dan tolong jangan terburu-buru saat mencicipi makanan enak, hati-hati jangan sampai tersedak seperti dulu.

column1: Mhm! I will! Goodbye, Tokarev!
column2: Mhm! Pasti! Sampai jumpa, Tokarev!

column1: ...Goodbye, have a safe trip.
column2: ...Sampai jumpa, semoga selamat di perjalanan.

column1: (Watching that always energetic back disappear into the distance, the curve of Tokarev's mouth stiffens slightly.)
column2: (Menatap punggung yang selalu bersemangat itu menghilang di kejauhan, lengkung mulut Tokarev sedikit mengeras.)

column1: (Perhaps she is naturally bad at goodbyes. Even a simple 'goodbye' feels exceptionally heavy for her to say.)
column2: (Mungkin dia memang tidak pandai berpamitan. Bahkan 'sampai jumpa' yang sederhana terasa luar biasa berat untuk dia ucapkan.)

column1: Tokarev, I'm leaving too!
column2: Tokarev, aku juga pergi!

column1: I want to temporarily leave this industry and pursue the dream I mentioned to the Commander before.
column2: Aku ingin sementara meninggalkan bidang ini dan mengejar mimpi yang pernah kuceritakan pada Commander.

column1: When the day of my debut comes, I will definitely send you tickets to my first performance!
column2: Saat hari debutku tiba, aku pasti mengirimimu tiket pertunjukan pertamaku!

column1: I will always be looking forward to it, Miss K2.
column2: Aku akan selalu menantikannya, Miss K2.

column1: The way you shine on stage will definitely be even more dazzling than on the training ground.
column2: Caramu bersinar di panggung pasti akan lebih menyilaukan daripada di lapangan latihan.

column1: If you encounter difficulties, please don't push yourself too hard.
column2: Kalau kau menemui kesulitan, tolong jangan terlalu memaksakan diri.

column1: Hehe, of course!
column2: Hehe, tentu!

column1: However... it would be great if the Commander could sit in the audience and watch my debut performance.
column2: Namun... alangkah bagusnya kalau Commander bisa duduk di kursi penonton dan menyaksikan pertunjukan debutku.

column1: Talking about this is a bit heavy, haha... Anyway, goodbye, Tokarev.
column2: Membicarakan ini agak berat, haha... Pokoknya, sampai jumpa, Tokarev.

column1: 再见。
column2: Sampai jumpa.

column1: (Stay calm.)
column2: (Tetap tenang.)

column1: (Maintain your composure.)
column2: (Jaga ketenanganmu.)

column1: (Maintain the final shred of dignity.)
column2: (Jaga sisa harga diri yang terakhir.)

column1: (I absolutely cannot let everyone, who has made up their minds to step into a new life, leave with worries.)
column2: (Aku sama sekali tidak boleh membiarkan mereka yang sudah memantapkan hati melangkah ke hidup baru pergi dengan kekhawatiran.)

column1: Tsk, the firewall set up by those URNC guys is like an iron turtle! 'Prohibited from actively contacting the former Commander through any channels'?! Are you kidding me!
column2: Cih, firewall yang dipasang orang-orang URNC itu seperti kura-kura besi! 'Dilarang secara aktif menghubungi mantan Commander lewat kanal apa pun'?! Kalian bercanda!

column1: Don't underestimate the power of a legendary Cyber Media streamer! A mere firewall, believe it or not, I'll find a cybersecurity assistant to tear it down later!
column2: Jangan remehkan kekuatan streamer Cyber Media yang legendaris! Firewall doang, mau percaya atau tidak, nanti aku cari asisten keamanan siber untuk merobeknya!

column1: Hmph, I'll leave secret codes in those stream links and hidden posts right now! Only our people will be able to understand them, the Commander will definitely see them!
column2: Hmph, aku akan menaruh kode rahasia di tautan siaran dan postingan tersembunyi itu sekarang! Hanya orang kita yang bisa memahaminya, Commander pasti akan melihatnya!

column1: Miss MDR, please don't do anything too dangerous.
column2: Miss MDR, tolong jangan melakukan hal yang terlalu berbahaya.

column1: The URNC's protocols are not child's play. If you are tracked down due to illegal operations, it will not only bring you huge trouble, but also betray everything the Commander did to protect us.
column2: Protokol URNC bukan mainan anak-anak. Kalau kau terlacak karena operasi ilegal, itu bukan cuma membawa masalah besar untukmu, tapi juga mengkhianati semua yang Commander lakukan untuk melindungi kita.

column1: I know, I'll switch to a more covert method. You just worry too much normally.
column2: Aku tahu, aku akan beralih ke cara yang lebih tersembunyi. Kau memang biasanya terlalu banyak khawatir.

column1: Take care of yourself too. If you run into unreasonable employers after leaving, remember you can always find me on the dark web.
column2: Jaga dirimu juga. Kalau kau bertemu majikan yang tidak masuk akal setelah pergi, ingat kau selalu bisa menemuiku di dark web.

column1: Ah! And remember to watch my stream! The world's number one streamer—Kuro is back!
column2: Ah! Dan ingat tonton siaranku! Streamer nomor satu sedunia—Kuro sudah kembali!

column1: Bye-bye~~
column2: Dadah~~

column1: Goodbye.
column2: Sampai jumpa.

column1: (When the last companion who chose to leave today disappeared from sight, Tokarev just felt so tired... so tired...)
column2: (Saat rekan terakhir yang memilih pergi hari itu hilang dari pandangan, Tokarev hanya merasa begitu lelah... begitu lelah...)

column1: (The wind swept up a few fallen leaves from the ground, swirling them around on the empty ground.)
column2: (Angin menyapu beberapa daun kering dari tanah, memutarnya di atas tanah yang kosong.)

column1: (Tokarev leaned against the cold wall. That constantly taut string called 'decency' had finally reached its limit.)
column2: (Tokarev bersandar ke dinding yang dingin. Dawai yang terus ditarik kencang bernama 'kepantasan' itu akhirnya sampai di batasnya.)

column1: (She slowly slid down to the ground, curled up her body, and buried her head deeply in her knees.)
column2: (Dia perlahan melorot ke tanah, meringkukkan tubuhnya, dan membenamkan kepalanya dalam-dalam di lututnya.)

column1: (Goodbye... all my friends from Griffin...)
column2: (Sampai jumpa... semua temanku dari Griffin...)

column1: (But where... should I go now...)
column2: (Tapi ke mana... aku harus pergi sekarang...)

column1: (Yes, she knew better than anyone that this day would come.)
column2: (Ya, dia lebih tahu dari siapa pun bahwa hari ini akan datang.)

column1: (Ever since the "agreement" protecting them took effect, everyone in Griffin has become completely free. Choosing to go their separate ways is only natural.)
column2: (Sejak "kesepakatan" yang melindungi mereka berlaku, semua orang di Griffin jadi sepenuhnya bebas. Memilih berpisah jalan itu wajar.)

column1: (This is the best outcome for everyone, and it is also the final gift... that person gave them with all their might.)
column2: (Ini hasil terbaik untuk semua orang, dan juga hadiah terakhir... yang orang itu berikan pada mereka dengan seluruh tenaganya.)

column1: (Beep beep!)
column2: (Tit tit!)

column1: (A crisp terminal notification sound rings abruptly, pulling her back to reality from the suffocating loneliness.)
column2: (Bunyi notifikasi terminal yang nyaring berbunyi mendadak, menariknya kembali ke kenyataan dari kesepian yang menyesakkan.)

column1: Makarov: | Miss Lee has made her decision. She will officially leave Griffin next week, and tonight we will hold an internal farewell banquet for her. | If you have time, Tokarev, come join us too.
column2: Makarov: | Miss Lee sudah mengambil keputusan. Dia akan resmi meninggalkan Griffin minggu depan, dan malam ini kami mengadakan jamuan perpisahan internal untuknya. | Kalau kau ada waktu, Tokarev, datanglah bergabung.

column1: Eh... even Miss Lee... is leaving too...
column2: Eh... bahkan Miss Lee... juga pergi...

column1: (Even though Griffin has entered the final stages of disbandment, this farewell banquet is still prepared exceptionally lavishly.)
column2: (Meski Griffin sudah masuk tahap akhir pembubaran, jamuan perpisahan itu tetap disiapkan luar biasa mewah.)

column1: (In Helian's words: 'We can't take the stored supplies with us, and it's a waste not to eat them, so we might as well splurge and enjoy them.')
column2: (Kata Helian: 'Perbekalan yang tersimpan tidak bisa kita bawa, dan sayang kalau tidak dimakan, jadi sekalian saja kita habiskan dan nikmati.')

column1: (The hall was brightly lit, the sound of music intertwining with the crisp clinking of glasses. Lee-Enfield and a few other Dolls who had decided on their future paths were smiling as they gave their farewell speeches.)
column2: (Aula itu terang benderang, suara musik berjalin dengan dentingan gelas yang nyaring. Lee-Enfield dan beberapa Doll lain yang sudah memutuskan jalan masa depannya tersenyum sembari menyampaikan pidato perpisahan.)

column1: (This should have been a warm moment of exchanging well-wishes and blessings, but Tokarev felt a tightness in her chest. Halfway through the banquet, she slipped out alone to the steps outside the hall, holding an untouched glass of juice.)
column2: (Itu seharusnya momen hangat untuk bertukar doa dan restu, tapi dada Tokarev terasa sesak. Di tengah jamuan, dia menyelinap keluar sendirian ke tangga di luar aula, memegang segelas jus yang belum disentuh.)

column1: I'm sorry... everyone, I really don't want to ruin the mood...
column2: Maafkan aku... semuanya, aku benar-benar tidak ingin merusak suasana...

column1: But I really... don't know what kind of expression to wear to face this final farewell...
column2: Tapi aku benar-benar... tidak tahu ekspresi apa yang harus kupakai untuk menghadapi perpisahan terakhir ini...

column1: (The night breeze is slightly cool. The noisy laughter from the hall comes through the glass doors, but it feels as if it belongs to another world.)
column2: (Angin malam terasa agak sejuk. Tawa riuh dari dalam aula menembus pintu kaca, tapi terasa seperti milik dunia lain.)

column1: (A light and elegant sound of footsteps comes from behind.)
column2: (Bunyi langkah yang ringan dan elegan datang dari belakang.)

column1: Miss Tokarev? Are you here?
column2: Miss Tokarev? Kau di sini?

column1: (A gentle and steady voice comes from behind. Tokarev, sitting on the steps, turns her head in surprise.)
column2: (Suara yang lembut dan mantap datang dari belakang. Tokarev yang duduk di tangga menoleh dengan kaget.)

column1: Shouldn't you be the absolute center of the party right now? Why are you here...
column2: Bukankah kau seharusnya jadi pusat pesta sekarang? Kenapa kau di sini...

column1: ...That's how it was supposed to be.
column2: ...Seharusnya memang begitu.

column1: It's just that everyone is so enthusiastic tonight, it's a bit hard to handle, so I made an excuse to come out for some fresh air.
column2: Hanya saja malam ini semuanya begitu bersemangat sampai agak sulit dihadapi, jadi aku beralasan keluar untuk cari udara segar.

column1: (Lee-Enfield gently gathered her shawl and walked to Tokarev's side.)
column2: (Lee-Enfield merapatkan selendangnya dengan lembut dan melangkah ke sisi Tokarev.)

column1: Miss Tokarev, do you mind if I sit next to you?
column2: Miss Tokarev, keberatan kalau aku duduk di sebelahmu?

column1: Ah, of course I don't mind! Please, have a seat.
column2: Ah, tentu tidak keberatan! Silakan duduk.

column1: (Tokarev quickly shifted her body, making room for half the seat.)
column2: (Tokarev cepat menggeser tubuhnya, memberi ruang separuh tempat duduk.)

column1: (The moonlight, like water, quietly spilled over the two of them.)
column2: (Cahaya bulan bagai air tumpah dalam diam ke tubuh keduanya.)

column1: Miss Tokarev, are you alright?
column2: Miss Tokarev, kau baik-baik saja?

column1: I noticed you seemed a bit down at the banquet just now. Did I make things difficult for you by presumptuously having Makarov invite you?
column2: Aku menyadari kau tampak agak murung di jamuan tadi. Apa aku menyulitkanmu karena lancang menyuruh Makarov mengundangmu?

column1: Ah! No, no, please don't think that. I'm very honored to be able to attend your farewell party.
column2: Ah! Tidak, tidak, tolong jangan berpikir begitu. Aku sangat terhormat bisa hadir di pesta perpisahanmu.

column1: I'm actually very happy! Look—
column2: Aku sebenarnya sangat senang! Lihat—

column1: (Tokarev tries to turn her head and show Lee-Enfield a standard, radiant smile.)
column2: (Tokarev mencoba menoleh dan memperlihatkan senyum cerah yang standar kepada Lee-Enfield.)

column1: (However, the sadness in her eyes cannot be hidden no matter what. That forced smile is so stiff that it makes one's heart ache.)
column2: (Namun kesedihan di matanya tidak bisa disembunyikan dengan cara apa pun. Senyum yang dipaksakan itu begitu kaku sampai menyakitkan hati.)

column1: (Under the other's gentle and tolerant gaze, Tokarev finally gives up her disguise, her shoulders slumping slightly.)
column2: (Di bawah tatapan lembut dan penuh maklum lawan bicaranya, Tokarev akhirnya melepas topengnya, bahunya sedikit merosot.)

column1: ...I'm sorry, I shouldn't have deceived you.
column2: ...Maafkan aku, aku seharusnya tidak membohongimu.

column1: I just... just am not good at saying goodbye... Griffin is the most important place to me...
column2: Aku cuma... cuma tidak pandai berpamitan... Griffin tempat yang paling penting bagiku...

column1: The Commander is... the most important person to me...
column2: Commander adalah... orang yang paling penting bagiku...

column1: And all of this will become the past... I don't know what I should do.
column2: Dan semua ini akan menjadi masa lalu... Aku tidak tahu harus bagaimana.

column1: Miss Lee... watching everyone leave so decisively one by one, am I... being too weak?
column2: Miss Lee... menyaksikan semuanya pergi setegas itu satu per satu, apa aku... terlalu lemah?

column1: You really don't need to be so hard on yourself. Just like you, I feel a deep sense of reluctance and sorrow over the fading of all this.
column2: Kau benar-benar tidak perlu sekeras itu pada dirimu sendiri. Sama sepertimu, aku merasakan keengganan dan duka yang dalam atas memudarnya semua ini.

column1: Your emotions are completely normal and reasonable. In front of us, you don't need to pretend to be strong.
column2: Emosimu sepenuhnya normal dan wajar. Di depan kami, kau tidak perlu berpura-pura kuat.

column1: Not just you and me... but everyone who left with a smile, they're all the same.
column2: Bukan cuma kau dan aku... tapi semua yang pergi dengan senyum, mereka semua sama.

column1: Frankly, hearing you let your guard down and speak your mind like this actually makes me feel relieved. MDR and K2 specifically contacted me before they left; they've actually been very worried about you.
column2: Terus terang, mendengarmu melepas penjagaan dan bicara jujur seperti ini justru membuatku lega. MDR dan K2 khusus menghubungiku sebelum pergi; sebenarnya mereka sangat mengkhawatirkanmu.

column1: Everyone... I'm sorry...
column2: Semuanya... maafkan aku...

column1: There's no need for this, we are all Dolls under the Commander's command. We are comrades, companions... and also family without blood ties.
column2: Tidak perlu begitu, kita semua Doll di bawah komando Commander. Kita rekan seperjuangan, sahabat... dan juga keluarga tanpa ikatan darah.

column1: If you are willing, could you tell me your true troubles right now?
column2: Kalau kau bersedia, bisakah kau menceritakan kegelisahanmu yang sebenarnya sekarang?

column1: (After hesitating again and again, Tokarev slowly spoke of the deepest worry buried in her neural cloud.)
column2: (Setelah ragu berkali-kali, Tokarev perlahan menceritakan kekhawatiran terdalam yang terpendam di neural cloud-nya.)

column1: I... I am full of reluctance to leave Griffin, but at the same time, I also feel anxious about my own incompetence.
column2: Aku... aku penuh keengganan meninggalkan Griffin, tapi pada waktu yang sama aku juga cemas atas ketidakmampuanku sendiri.

column1: Actually, I noticed long ago, whether it's Miss MDR, Miss K2, or everyone else who left before... they have all found their own paths.
column2: Sebenarnya aku sudah lama menyadarinya, baik Miss MDR, Miss K2, maupun semua yang pergi sebelumnya... mereka semua sudah menemukan jalannya sendiri.

column1: They all seem to have inherited some kind of power from the Commander, and following that path, they firmly stepped into the next stage, believing that by following this path they will definitely be able to touch the Commander again.
column2: Mereka semua seolah mewarisi semacam kekuatan dari Commander, dan mengikuti jalan itu, mereka melangkah mantap ke tahap berikutnya, percaya dengan mengikuti jalan itu mereka pasti bisa menyentuh Commander lagi.

column1: And what about me...
column2: Sedangkan aku...

column1: Even though I saw the Commander at that final moment... I am still so at a loss right now.
column2: Meski aku melihat Commander di saat terakhir itu... sekarang aku tetap begitu kebingungan.

column1: I've heard of your deeds. I didn't expect that while everyone was forced into dormancy, Miss Tokarev could assemble a temporary team, assist the Commander, and participate in the final battle.
column2: Aku pernah mendengar perbuatanmu. Aku tidak menyangka saat semua orang dipaksa tidur, Miss Tokarev bisa menyusun tim sementara, membantu Commander, dan ikut dalam pertempuran terakhir.

column1: You did very well, thank you.
column2: Kau melakukannya dengan sangat baik, terima kasih.

column1: (However, upon hearing Lee-Enfield's words, Tokarev did not smile.)
column2: (Namun mendengar kata-kata Lee-Enfield, Tokarev tidak tersenyum.)

column1: Thank you very much for your praise, but in the most critical battle...
column2: Terima kasih banyak atas pujianmu, tapi di pertempuran yang paling krusial...

column1: I didn't help much, it was Miss Dandelion who fought to the end.
column2: Aku tidak banyak membantu, Miss Dandelion yang bertarung sampai akhir.

column1: I merely lent out my Frame... anyone could have done that.
column2: Aku hanya meminjamkan Frame-ku... siapa pun bisa melakukan itu.

column1: ...Miss Tokarev is too strict with herself.
column2: ...Miss Tokarev terlalu keras pada dirinya sendiri.

column1: In the situation where the Commander needed it most, it was you who used your own power to help him.
column2: Dalam situasi saat Commander paling membutuhkannya, kaulah yang memakai kekuatanmu sendiri untuk membantunya.

column1: Thank you for comforting me... but I know in my heart...
column2: Terima kasih sudah menghiburku... tapi aku tahu di hatiku...

column1: Because I feel like I haven't done anything, I have no idea how to enjoy this freedom with peace of mind from now on...
column2: Karena aku merasa belum melakukan apa pun, aku sama sekali tidak tahu bagaimana menikmati kebebasan ini dengan tenang mulai sekarang...

column1: Once I leave here, I'll have nothing. How am I supposed to use this gift called 'freedom' that the Commander risked their life to get for me?
column2: Begitu aku pergi dari sini, aku tidak punya apa-apa. Bagaimana aku harus memakai hadiah bernama 'kebebasan' yang Commander pertaruhkan nyawanya untuk kudapatkan?

column1: I... I really don't know.
column2: Aku... aku benar-benar tidak tahu.

column1: How I wish someone could stand in front of me right now, give me a clear order, and tell me what I should do.
column2: Betapa aku berharap ada yang berdiri di depanku sekarang, memberiku perintah yang jelas, dan memberitahuku apa yang harus kulakukan.

column1: (Tokarev's throat choked violently, her eyes slightly red, and for a moment she couldn't speak.)
column2: (Tenggorokan Tokarev tercekat keras, matanya sedikit memerah, dan sesaat dia tidak bisa bicara.)

column1: (A long silence fell between the two of them.)
column2: (Kesunyian yang panjang jatuh di antara keduanya.)

column1: (At this time, the moon was bright and the stars were sparse, and the night breeze brushed past.)
column2: (Saat itu bulan terang dan bintangnya jarang, dan angin malam menyapu lewat.)

column1: (Fallen leaves from afar were carried over, swirling once on the ground before being blown away again by the wind—leaving nothing behind.)
column2: (Daun kering dari kejauhan terbawa kemari, berputar sekali di tanah sebelum kembali diterbangkan angin—tanpa meninggalkan apa pun.)

column1: (Sometimes, the meetings and partings between people are just like the waxing and waning of the moon.)
column2: (Kadang pertemuan dan perpisahan antarorang seperti bulan yang purnama lalu susut.)

column1: (Desolate, lonely, hesitant, melancholic. It has always been so.)
column2: (Gersang, sepi, ragu, muram. Selalu begitu.)

column1: ...Before lending my frame to Miss Dandelion, I never thought that would be the last time I saw the Commander.
column2: ...Sebelum meminjamkan frame-ku kepada Miss Dandelion, aku tidak pernah berpikir itu kali terakhir aku melihat Commander.

column1: I couldn't even properly say goodbye to him with my own consciousness.
column2: Aku bahkan tidak bisa berpamitan dengan benar padanya memakai kesadaranku sendiri.

column1: Whenever I think of that moment, my neural cloud feels as painful as if it's being torn apart.
column2: Setiap kali aku mengingat momen itu, neural cloud-ku terasa sakit seperti dicabik-cabik.

column1: The current Griffin is the same... every time someone leaves, when everyone says goodbye, they always smile and say 'we will reunite somewhere sooner or later'.
column2: Griffin yang sekarang juga sama... setiap kali ada yang pergi, saat semuanya berpamitan, mereka selalu tersenyum dan bilang 'cepat atau lambat kita akan bertemu lagi di suatu tempat'.

column1: But when exactly is that day? Who can guarantee that it's not a lie for self-comfort?
column2: Tapi kapan tepatnya hari itu? Siapa yang bisa menjamin itu bukan kebohongan untuk menghibur diri?

column1: Everyone scattered all over the place, the White Zone, Green Zone, Yellow Zone... some have even gone far into the wasteland.
column2: Semuanya tersebar ke mana-mana, White Zone, Green Zone, Yellow Zone... sebagian bahkan pergi jauh ke tanah tandus.

column1: How are we going to contact each other in the future? What if someone encounters danger?
column2: Bagaimana kita saling menghubungi nanti? Bagaimana kalau ada yang kena bahaya?

column1: Shouldn't we agree on a time and place to reunite...
column2: Bukankah kita seharusnya menyepakati waktu dan tempat untuk berkumpul lagi...

column1: Can we... really see the Commander again? Is there any other way we can re-establish a secret communication network...| so that if the Commander encounters danger, we can quickly provide support?
column2: Apa kita... benar-benar bisa bertemu Commander lagi? Apa ada cara lain untuk membangun ulang jaringan komunikasi rahasia...| supaya kalau Commander kena bahaya, kita bisa cepat memberi bantuan?

column1: Sorry... Miss Lee, I lost control of my emotions a bit and kept randomly outputting these meaningless redundant data.
